$comment: The crosswalk as reviewers who teach to this curriculum wrote it, point by point, from the official text (scripts/curricula/apply-review.js --authored). `why` is the reviewer's reason; the registry's builder adds each row's grade and writes crosswalk.json.

K:position-words.why: The expectation asks children to describe 'Lagebeziehungen (u. a. rechts, links, über, unter, hinter, vor)' between pictured objects; the pre-school sheets build exactly these position words before school.

K:scene-search.why: Only the shape sheets count: finding a given shape in a scene and in everyday objects is a first step to 'identifizieren die geometrischen Grundformen'. The plain picture-search sheets have no counterpart in the plan.

K:compare-size-extremes.why: Finding the longest / tallest is direct comparison of lengths, the step before 'vergleichen und ordnen Längen' with units.

K:order-by-size.why: Seriation by size or height is the pre-school form of 'vergleichen und ordnen Längen'.

K:patterns.why: 'stellen Muster durch Legen und Fortsetzen her' is what the child does when extending AB / ABC patterns; describing and inventing own patterns, which the expectation also asks, comes in school.

K:one-to-one.why: One-to-one matching is the basis of counting ('zählen') and of comparing quantities ('ordnen und vergleichen Zahlen'); it comes before both.

K:compare-groups.why: More / fewer / equal with picture groups is the step before 'ordnen und vergleichen Zahlen im Zahlenraum bis 100'.

K:count-how-many.why: Counting a set and naming / writing / matching the number to 20 is the small-range start of 'zählen', 'benennen und schreiben Zahlen' and of switching between picture and numeral ('Anzahlerfassung ... Darstellungsformen') in the Zahlenraum bis 100.

K:subitize.why: Dice, dot and frame pictures are the first 'Strukturen in Zahldarstellungen zur Anzahlerfassung'; the mental-maths expectation names 'erfassen schnell strukturierte Anzahlen'.

K:conservation.why: That a number stays the same in any arrangement is a precondition for 'Anzahlerfassung' across different pictures of the same number; the plan does not name it on its own.

K:count-out-n.why: Making a set for a given numeral is the change from the symbolic to the pictorial form ('wechseln bei der Zahldarstellung ... zwischen den verschiedenen Darstellungsformen'), in a range to 10-20.

K:shape-naming.why: 'identifizieren die geometrischen Grundformen (Rechteck, Quadrat, Dreieck, Kreis)' is the target; the pre-school sheets name the shapes but do not yet describe them with 'Seite, Ecke'.

K:numeral-formation.why: Writing the numerals 0-9 and 11-20 is the first part of 'benennen und schreiben Zahlen im Zahlenraum bis 100'.

K:colour-by-number.why: The child only has to read numerals from a key; that is a small step toward 'benennen ... Zahlen'. No more of the plan is touched.

K:classify-count-kinds.why: Counting each kind in a mixed scene is counting plus finding frequencies, the step before 'stellen Daten und Häufigkeiten in Diagrammen und Tabellen dar'.

K:count-sides.why: Counting sides prepares describing the Grundformen 'mit Fachbegriffen (Seite, Ecke ...)'.

K:count-forward-missing.why: 'zählen ... vorwärts' in a range to 20; the expectation asks for the Zahlenraum bis 100, backward, in steps and from any start number.

K:dot-to-dot-sequence.why: Joining dots in counting order to 30, also from 11, practises the number sequence 'vorwärts ... beliebige Startzahl' in a small range.

K:one-more-one-less.why: 'ist der Vorgänger/Nachfolger von', 'ist um x kleiner/größer als': the sheets build the one-more / one-less idea with pictures before it is described with numbers.

K:before-after-back.why: Before / after / between is 'Vorgänger/Nachfolger'; counting backward from 10 is the start of 'zählen ... rückwärts'.

K:ordinal-position.why: No expectation in the list names ordinal numbers (Ordnungszahlen); they belong to the Schwerpunkt 'Zahlverständnis' as one aspect of number, so only the Schwerpunkt is given.

K:days-of-week.why: Sachunterricht asks to 'benennen unterschiedliche Zeiteinteilungen' (calendar), Mathematik to use the time units 'Tag, Woche'; knowing the weekdays in order comes before both.

K:tally-marks.why: A tally (Strichliste) is the first way to 'stellen Daten und Häufigkeiten ... dar'; the bundles of five are a structure used for 'Anzahlerfassung'.

K:estimate.why: Estimating a quantity and checking by counting belongs to the Schwerpunkt 'Zahlverständnis'; the listed expectations name counting and structured counting but not estimating a number of things (M.1.6 is about results of calculations, M.3.1.s3 about measures).

K:heavy-light.why: Weights appear only in the Klasse 4 column: 'vergleichen und ordnen Größen (u. a. ... Gewichte (Masse))'. Direct heavier / lighter comparison is an early step toward it.

K:draw-shapes.why: 'zeichnen Linien, ebene Figuren ... mit Hilfsmitteln (u. a. ... Gitterpapier)' and the terms 'Seite, Ecke' are the school targets of drawing named shapes on dot paper.

K:combine-groups.why: Putting two groups together is the 'Situation des ... Vereinigens'; the expectation asks to match such situations with Additionsaufgaben, which the pre-school sheets do not yet write.

K:take-away.why: Crossing out and counting the rest is the 'Situation des Abziehens' before it is matched with a Subtraktionsaufgabe.

K:count-on.why: Counting on from a known group is 'Hinzufügen' and counting from 'beliebige Startzahl' in a small range.

K:number-bonds-k.why: The mental-maths expectation names 'zerlegen Zahlen bis 10' and 'ergänzen auf Stufenzahlen'; the pre-school sheets do this with pictures, not yet as quick mental work.

K:compose-shapes.why: 'stellen ebene Figuren her durch Legen, Nachlegen und Auslegen, Zerlegen und Zusammensetzen' is what tangram work leads to.

K:mirror-image.why: Recognising a mirror image comes before 'identifizieren ... Eigenschaften der Achsensymmetrie (u. a. durch ... Spiegeln mit dem Spiegel)'.

K:odd-even-pairing.why: The plan does not name gerade / ungerade Zahlen; pairing up is the picture stage of the relation 'ist die Hälfte/das Doppelte von'.

K:teen-numbers.why: 13 as one ten and three ones is the first case of 'Struktur des Zehnersystems (Prinzip der Bündelung, Stellenwertschreibweise)'.

K:fact-fluency-colour-code.why: 'geben die Zahlensätze des kleinen Einspluseins automatisiert wieder' is an end-of-Klasse-2 demand; these sheets sit a year before school, so they can only prepare it.

K:number-bonds-20.why: Bonds to 20 are facts of the 'kleines Einspluseins' and their reversals; before school this is preparation.

1:add-within-10-models.why: The child matches a picture of two groups with an addition ('ordnen Situationen des ... Vereinigens und Additionsaufgaben einander zu') and moves between picture and number sentence ('wechseln zwischen verschiedenen Darstellungsformen von Operationen').

1:subtract-cross-out.why: Crossing out is the 'Situation des Abziehens' matched with a Subtraktionsaufgabe, shown 'bildlich' and 'symbolisch'.

1:write-the-equation.why: Writing the whole equation for a picture is the change from the pictorial to the symbolic form of an operation, for adding and for taking away.

1:patterns-missing.why: Completing a repeating pattern is the 'Fortsetzen' part of 'stellen Muster durch Legen und Fortsetzen her'; describing and inventing patterns is not on the sheet.

1:sort-three-groups.why: Sorting pictures into groups is the step before 'strukturieren Daten ... mithilfe von Tabellen'; the sheet has no table or count yet.

1:make-10.why: The wording names it: 'zerlegen Zahlen bis 10, ergänzen auf Stufenzahlen'.

1:shape-attributes.why: Naming the Grundformen and deciding by sides and corners whether a figure really is one is 'identifizieren ... und beschreiben diese mit Fachbegriffen (Seite, Ecke ...)'.

1:ordinal-numbers.why: Ordinal numbers are part of the Schwerpunkt 'Zahlverständnis' in Klasse 1, but no single listed expectation names them, so the Schwerpunkt id is used.

1:number-line-placement.why: Placing and reading numbers on a number line is 'ordnen ... Zahlen' and a change of representation; the range to 50 is a part of the Zahlenraum bis 100.

1:count-on-back-hops.why: Hops on the number line are counting 'vorwärts, rückwärts' and a pictorial form of adding and subtracting ('Darstellungsformen von Operationen').

1:word-problems.why: 'einfache Sachaufgaben (u. a. Rechengeschichten oder Bildsachaufgaben) ... lösen' with 'Zeichnungen' as help; the child matches the situation with an addition or subtraction. Asking own questions, also in the wording, is not on the sheet.

1:picture-graphs-sort-count.why: Sorting into a table, showing counts in a picture graph and reading 'most / how many more' from it are the three data expectations: 'strukturieren ... mithilfe von Tabellen', 'stellen ... in Diagrammen und Tabellen dar', 'entnehmen ... Diagrammen und Tabellen Daten'.

1:doubles-halves.why: 'verdoppeln und halbieren' is named in the mental-maths expectation, 'ist die Hälfte/das Doppelte von' in the number-relations one; to 20 is a part of the range.

1:odd-even-pairs.why: The plan does not name gerade / ungerade; sharing fairly between two works on 'ist die Hälfte ... von' and is the hands-on step before mental 'halbieren'.

1:near-doubles.why: 6 + 7 from 6 + 6 is 'rechnen vorteilhaft mithilfe von Zahlbeziehungen (u. a. Nachbarzahlen)' and a way to derive facts of the kleines Einspluseins.

1:add-three-addends.why: Adding three numbers within 20 is a part of addition 'im Zahlenraum bis 100 unter Ausnutzung von Rechengesetzen'; it gives the examples on which the Assoziativgesetz is later described.

1:fact-families.why: Four facts from three numbers is 'nutzen ... die Zusammenhänge der Operationen untereinander' and 'leiten deren Umkehrungen sicher ab'.

1:missing-number-equations.why: Finding the unknown uses the link between addition and subtraction and the reversals of the Einspluseins facts within 20.

1:true-false-equations.why: The listed content expectations do not name the meaning of the equal sign; what the child practises in their terms is the facts of the kleines Einspluseins on both sides of the sign.

1:bar-model.why: A part-whole bar is a pictorial form of the operation; missing part and 'how many more' are 'Ergänzen, Vergleichen'. As a sketch it prepares 'Bearbeitungshilfen wie Zeichnungen, Skizzen' for Sachaufgaben.

1:tangram-compose.why: 'Nachlegen und Auslegen, Zerlegen und Zusammensetzen und Vervollständigen' of plane figures is the tangram work itself.

1:days-months-seasons.why: 'benennen unterschiedliche Zeiteinteilungen ... (Jahreszeiten, ... Jahreskalender)' is met; the maths expectation on the time units 'Tag, Woche, Monat, Jahr' also asks for converting, which the sheets do not do.

1:measure-length-units.why: Ordering three objects by length is 'vergleichen und ordnen Längen'; measuring with cubes comes before 'ermitteln Längen mit Messgeräten (u. a. Lineal ...)'.

1:time-read.why: 'benennen einfache Uhrzeiten (u. a. volle Stunde, halbe Stunde ...) auf analogen und digitalen Uhren': the hour and half-hour part; quarter hours are still missing here.

1:fluency-within-20.why: The facts of the 'kleines Einspluseins' and the make-a-ten strategy ('Zerlegungsstrategien'), for the part of the range up to 20.

1:number-walls.why: Zahlenmauern practise the addition facts and, for a missing brick, their reversal ('Umkehrungen', 'Zusammenhänge der Operationen'); the range is judged from the year (within 20).

1:check-answers.why: Finding and correcting wrong results needs the Einspluseins facts; the range is judged from the year. Checking as such is a process competence, not listed.

1:bar-graphs.why: Colouring a bar graph from counts is 'stellen Daten und Häufigkeiten in Diagrammen ... dar'; reading the tallest bar is 'entnehmen ... Diagrammen ... Daten'.

1:tens-and-ones.why: 'stellen Zahlen im Zahlenraum bis 100 unter Anwendung der Struktur des Zehnersystems dar (Prinzip der Bündelung, Stellenwertschreibweise)' with rods and cubes, changing between material picture and numeral.

1:number-words.why: Number words are the 'sprachliche' form of a number; matching them with numerals is the change of representation and 'benennen und schreiben Zahlen'.

1:compare-order-two-digit.why: 'ordnen und vergleichen Zahlen im Zahlenraum bis 100', word for word.

1:hundreds-chart.why: Hundertertafel work: counting in the Zahlenraum bis 100 also in steps, the relations +1 / +10 between neighbours ('um x kleiner/größer als'), and putting numbers in order.

1:one-ten-more-less.why: 'ist der Vorgänger/Nachfolger von', 'ist um x kleiner/größer als' for x = 1 and 10.

1:number-of-the-day.why: One number in many forms is 'wechseln ... zwischen den verschiedenen Darstellungsformen'; tens/ones is the Zehnersystem; 10 more / less is a number relation.

1:skip-counting.why: 'zählen ... in Schritten' is named in both expectations; equal groups with a running total are the 'Situation des Wiederholens' before it is written as a multiplication.

1:time-set-hands.why: The s-expectation stops at 'volle Stunde, halbe Stunde, Viertelstunde, Dreiviertelstunde ... und stellen diese ein'; the five-minute and mixed sheets go toward the Klasse 4 expectation with any time.

1:coins.why: Counting coins is 'rechnen mit Größen (nur ganzzahlige Maßzahlen)' with 'ct, €'; comparing two purses is 'vergleichen ... Geldbeträge'.

1:open-number-line.why: The Rechenstrich is the usual 'halbschriftlich' way to add and subtract in the Zahlenraum bis 100 with 'Zerlegungsstrategien', and the drawn jumps are a written record of the own 'Rechenweg'.

1:mental-math-to-100.why: 'lösen Additions- und Subtraktionsaufgaben im Zahlenraum bis 100 ... mündlich oder halbschriftlich'; 34 + 20 is 'rechnen mit Zehnerzahlen'. In NRW this is Klasse 2 content, see notes.

1:bonds-to-100.why: 'ergänzen auf Stufenzahlen' in the Zahlenraum bis 100: the partner to 100.

2:bundle-ten-ones.why: 'Prinzip der Bündelung' is named in the expectation.

2:hundreds-chart-moves.why: Moves on the Hundertertafel are the relations 'um x kleiner/größer als' (1 and 10) and counting in steps in the Zahlenraum bis 100.

2:odd-even.why: Gerade / ungerade is not named in the list; an even number as n + n is the relation 'ist ... das Doppelte von', which is the nearest wording.

2:number-line-not-from-zero.why: Placing numbers on a part of the Zahlenstrahl to 100 is 'ordnen ... Zahlen' and work with a pictorial form of the number.

2:2d-attributes.why: Sorting by sides uses the term 'Seite' on the Grundformen; if five- and six-sided shapes are in the set, that leads on to 'weitere ebene Figuren (u. a. Sechseck ...)' of Klasse 4.

2:add-sub-within-100-practice.why: 'lösen Additions- und Subtraktionsaufgaben im Zahlenraum bis 100'; the puzzle form does not change the content.

2:two-step-word-problems.why: 'einfache Sachaufgaben ... lösen' within 100, matching each step with an addition or subtraction; two steps are the upper edge of 'einfach'.

2:measure-with-ruler.why: 'ermitteln Längen mit Messgeräten (u. a. Lineal ...)' in cm.

2:compare-lengths.why: Measure, compare ('vergleichen ... Längen') and find the difference ('rechnen mit Größen (nur ganzzahlige Maßzahlen)').

2:read-build-3-digit.why: By the end of Klasse 2 NRW asks only for the 'Zahlenraum bis 100'; three-digit numbers go beyond that and are a first step toward the Klasse 4 expectation 'bis 1.000.000'. In NRW this is Klasse 3 work.

2:expanded-form-digit-value.why: 'Stellenwertschreibweise' with hundreds: beyond the Zahlenraum bis 100 of the Schuleingangsphase, a first part of the Klasse 4 range.

2:chart-within-1000.why: Counting within 1000 is beyond 'zählen im Zahlenraum bis 100' and a first part of 'zählen im Zahlenraum bis 1.000.000'.

2:skip-count-5-10-100.why: Steps of 5 and 10 are 'zählen ... in Schritten' within 100; steps of 100 leave that range and prepare the Klasse 4 expectation.

2:compare-order-3-digit.why: Same line of learning as 'ordnen und vergleichen Zahlen', but beyond 100; a first part of the range 'bis 1.000.000'.

2:hundred-more-less.why: 'ist um x kleiner/größer als' has no range in its wording and runs through all four years; with three-digit numbers it is first mental work 'im erweiterten Zahlenraum'.

2:time-5-min-quarter.why: 'Viertelstunde, Dreiviertelstunde' are in the s-expectation; times to five minutes are not 'einfache Uhrzeiten' and lead to the Klasse 4 expectation.

2:calendar.why: 'entnehmen Kalendern ... Daten' is named in Mathematik, 'Jahreskalender' in Sachunterricht; a week later and days between use the units 'Tag, Woche'.

2:flat-or-solid.why: Telling plane figures from solids is part of identifying Grundformen and Körper and of 'sortieren sie nach Eigenschaften'.

2:solids-in-real-life.why: 'identifizieren die geometrischen Körper Würfel, Quader und Kugel (auch in der Umwelt)' is met; cylinder, cone and pyramid belong to the Klasse 4 expectation ('u. a. Pyramide, Zylinder').

2:3d-faces-edges-vertices.why: Describing cube and Quader 'mit Fachbegriffen' (Fläche, Kante, Ecke) is the s-expectation; the same for pyramids, cylinders and cones is Klasse 3/4.

2:add-with-blocks.why: Adding with block pictures is a change between forms of an operation; within 1000 it goes beyond 'im Zahlenraum bis 100' and prepares the Klasse 3/4 arithmetic.

2:subtract-with-blocks.why: As for adding with blocks: pictorial form of the operation, beyond the Zahlenraum bis 100.

2:column-method.why: 'schriftliche Rechenverfahren' appear only in the Klasse 4 column; NRW starts them in Klasse 3, so a Klasse 2 sheet is a first step, not the secure use the wording asks ('sicher ausführen').

2:shopping-money.why: Adding prices, comparing with the money at hand and making change are 'rechnen mit Größen', 'vergleichen ... Geldbeträge' in a Sachsituation, as long as the prices are whole euro or whole cent ('nur ganzzahlige Maßzahlen'); 'enough money?' prepares Sachunterricht's 'Bedeutung der verfügbaren Mittel für Kaufentscheidungen'.

2:bar-graphs.why: Making a bar graph from a tally and answering questions from it: 'stellen Daten ... in Diagrammen und Tabellen dar', 'entnehmen ... Diagrammen ... Daten und interpretieren sie'.

2:line-plots.why: A line plot is one kind of Diagramm from which data are read; the form itself is unusual in German books.

2:round-to-ten.why: 'runden' is named only in the Klasse 4 expectation; rounding to the ten is the tool needed before a child can 'die ungefähre Größenordnung der Ergebnisse ... angeben'.

2:mass-grams.why: Weights and the units 'g, kg' appear only in the Klasse 4 column ('ermitteln Größen (u. a. ... Gewichte (Masse)) mit geeigneten Messgeräten'); reading pictured scales in Klasse 2 is a step toward it.

2:read-jugs.why: 'Rauminhalte' and 'Volumina (ml, l)' are Klasse 3/4 in NRW; reading a pictured measuring jug is a step toward measuring with the real one.

2:choose-units.why: cm or m is 'Stützpunktvorstellungen (für 1cm, 1m ...)' and use of the length units; g / kg and ml / l are units of the Klasse 4 column. Inches and feet have no place in a German sheet.

2:equal-groups-times.why: 'ordnen Situationen des Wiederholens, Zusammenfassens ... und Multiplikationsaufgaben einander zu', moving from picture to repeated addition to the multiplication sentence. In NRW this is Klasse 2.

2:arrays.why: A Punktefeld is the standard picture for multiplication; matching it with a Malaufgabe is the change of representation.

2:skip-count-3-4.why: 'zählen ... in Schritten'; the rows of 3 and 4 prepare the Einmaleins facts that are derived from the Kernaufgaben.

2:scaled-pictograph.why: Reading and making a picture graph is showing and reading 'Daten und Häufigkeiten in Diagrammen'; one picture for 2 is a small rise in demand, still inside the wording.

2:share-and-group.why: Sharing into bins is 'Verteilen', counting equal groups is 'Aufteilen'; the expectation links both with Divisionsaufgaben, which NRW begins in Klasse 2.

2:equal-shares-shapes.why: The NRW primary plan has no fraction strand; its only fraction wording is 'im Alltag gebräuchliche Bruchzahlen bei Größenangaben ... (¼, ½, ¾)' in Klasse 3/4. Halves and fourths of shapes are the idea before that; thirds are outside it.

2:fraction-of-a-set.why: Half of a set is 'ist die Hälfte ... von'; a third and a fourth of a set have no expectation of their own and only prepare the everyday fractions of Klasse 3/4.

2:symmetry-line.why: Deciding whether a line is a mirror line is 'identifizieren bei einfachen ebenen Figuren Eigenschaften der Achsensymmetrie'.

2:symmetry-complete.why: Completing a half picture uses the properties of the mirror line and is drawing on 'Gitterpapier'; making symmetric figures ('Zeichnen von Spiegelbildern auf Gitterpapier') is worded as a Klasse 4 expectation, so the Klasse 2 sheet prepares it.

2:grid-coordinates.why: No expectation of classes 1/2 names grid codes; finding square B2 is a step toward describing positions from 'Plänen' and toward finding places on maps (Planquadrate) in Klasse 3/4.

2:tangram-orientation.why: Matching a laid figure to its outline is 'Nachlegen und Auslegen'; rejecting turned and flipped ones needs moving figures in the mind, which the plan asks by Klasse 4 ('verändern die Lage von ebenen Figuren ... in der Vorstellung').

3:compare-4-digit.why: 'ordnen und vergleichen Zahlen im Zahlenraum bis 1.000.000': the four-digit part.

3:rounding.why: The 'runden' named in the Klasse 4 expectation, for tens and hundreds.

3:column-regrouping.why: 'führen die schriftlichen Rechenverfahren der Addition, Subtraktion ... sicher aus': the addition and subtraction part within 1000 (multiplication is missing). Explaining the steps in words, the other expectation, is not what the sheets ask.

3:estimate-by-rounding.why: 'geben die ungefähre Größenordnung der Ergebnisse ... an, runden' and 'prüfen sie auf Plausibilität': exactly the Überschlag and the check of the exact answer.

3:magic-squares.why: A Zauberquadrat is practice of adding and finding the missing addend in a puzzle form; only the addition / subtraction part of 'Aufgaben aller vier Grundrechenarten' is met, and the range is judged from the year.

3:parity-of-sums.why: The list has no wording for even / odd rules; predicting the parity of a sum goes beyond 'beschreiben Beziehungen zwischen Zahlen' into reasoning about number patterns (in NRW a process competence).

3:arithmetic-patterns.why: 'beschreiben Beziehungen ... in Zahlenfolgen' and 'zählen ... in Schritten' in the wider number range (steps of 25, 50, 100).

3:time-to-minute.why: 'benennen Uhrzeiten auf analogen und auf digitalen Uhren' with no limit to simple times.

3:mult-equal-groups.why: Product as equal groups or an array: 'Situationen des Wiederholens, Zusammenfassens ... und Multiplikationsaufgaben einander zuordnen'. NRW begins this in Klasse 2.

3:mult-number-line.why: Equal jumps are a pictorial form of multiplication ('Wiederholen').

3:commutative.why: 'nutzen und beschreiben Rechengesetze an Beispielen (Kommutativgesetz ...)'; turning the array is the usual example (Tauschaufgabe).

3:times-tables.why: 'geben alle Zahlensätze des kleinen Einmaleins automatisiert wieder' (Klasse 4); deriving facts from neighbours is what NRW already asks at the end of Klasse 2: 'leiten weitere Aufgaben des kleinen Einmaleins daraus ab'.

3:scaled-graphs.why: Building and reading bar graphs and pictographs with a scale: 'stellen Daten und Häufigkeiten in Diagrammen und Tabellen dar', 'entnehmen ... Diagrammen ... Daten'.

3:thermometer.why: Reading a scale that counts in 2s, 5s or 10s is part of 'ermitteln Größen (u. a. ...) mit geeigneten Messgeräten'; temperature is covered only by the 'u. a.', it is not one of the named measures.

3:division-sharing.why: 'Situationen des ... Verteilens und Divisionsaufgaben einander zuordnen'.

3:division-repeated-subtraction.why: How many equal hops is 'Aufteilen', shown on the number line as a pictorial form of the division.

3:mult-div-relationship.why: 'nutzen und erklären die Zusammenhänge der Operationen untereinander' and 'leiten deren Umkehraufgaben sicher ab'.

3:muldiv-word-problems.why: Sachaufgaben solved by deciding between groups and group size: the situations of multiplying, 'Aufteilen' and 'Verteilen'.

3:input-output.why: Finding the rule is describing a relation between numbers ('ist um x kleiner/größer als', double); working backward uses the reverse operation.

3:balance-equations.why: The plan's content list has no wording for the equal sign; finding the missing number by the reverse operation is 'nutzen ... die Zusammenhänge der Operationen'.

3:add-subtract-time.why: 'rechnen mit Größen' with hours and minutes, reading and setting any clock time.

3:elapsed-duration.why: Finding a Zeitspanne between two clock times is calculating with time measures after reading both clocks.

3:time-12-24.why: Naming times 'auf analogen und auf digitalen Uhren' includes the 24-hour form of the digital clock.

3:area-model.why: 'bestimmen ... den Flächeninhalt ebener Figuren ... (u. a. durch Auslegen mit Einheitsquadraten)'; rows times columns links it with multiplication.

3:same-area.why: 'bestimmen und vergleichen den Flächeninhalt ebener Figuren'.

3:same-perimeter.why: Comparing 'Flächeninhalt ... und deren Umfang' of figures against each other.

3:division-remainder.why: Division with a remainder in the Einmaleins range is part of 'Aufgaben aller vier Grundrechenarten ... mündlich oder halbschriftlich'; it prepares the written division 'mit Verwendung der Restschreibweise' of Klasse 4.

3:right-angles.why: 'beschreiben diese mit Fachbegriffen (u. a. senkrecht, waagerecht, parallel, rechter Winkel)'.

3:classify-quadrilaterals.why: 'identifizieren weitere ebene Figuren (u. a. ... Parallelogramm) und beschreiben diese mit Fachbegriffen'; that a square is also a rectangle is at the top of what the wording asks.

3:symmetry.why: Finding all mirror lines goes beyond the s-expectation's 'einfache ebene Figuren'; the Klasse 4 expectation asks for making symmetric figures, for which this is the groundwork.

3:partition-equal-areas.why: NRW names fractions only as 'im Alltag gebräuchliche Bruchzahlen bei Größenangaben ... (¼, ½, ¾)'; equal parts of shapes named as unit fractions are the idea behind them.

3:fraction-unit-build.why: Three quarters as three pieces of one quarter is the understanding needed for ¾ in measures; other fractions are outside the NRW primary plan.

3:whole-from-unit.why: That four quarters make the whole is what a child needs to 'wandeln diese in kleinere Einheiten um' (¼ h = 15 min); the plan has no fraction expectation beyond that.

3:fraction-number-line.why: Fractions as numbers on a number line go beyond the everyday fractions with measures that NRW asks in primary school; this is Klasse 5/6 content in Germany.

3:compare-fractions.why: Comparing fractions is not in the NRW primary plan; it lies beyond 'gebräuchliche Bruchzahlen bei Größenangaben' on the same line.

3:equivalent-fractions.why: Equivalent fractions are secondary-school content in NRW; only 2/4 = ½ touches the everyday fractions named.

3:fraction-of-set.why: A fraction of a number of things is the same thinking as turning ½ or ¼ of a unit into smaller units, but with thirds and other fractions the plan does not name.

3:line-plot-halves.why: Measuring lengths and showing the data in a diagram are both Klasse 3/4 expectations; half units are a use of '½ ... bei Größenangaben'. The line plot form is not usual in German books.

3:volume-cubes.why: 'bestimmen und vergleichen den Rauminhalt von Körpern mit Einheitswürfeln'.

K:pre-writing-strokes.why: Schwungübungen train the pencil hold and the strokes needed before 'schreiben flüssig und formklar in Druckschrift'.

K:all-about-me-personal.why: Drawing and telling about oneself comes before 'schreiben freie Texte zu eigenen Interessen und Erlebnissen' and before naming 'eigene Gefühle, Bedürfnisse und Interessen'.

K:rhyme.why: Hearing rhymes is phonological awareness, the ground for the 'Lautprinzip'; it is also first play with the sound of language ('gehen experimentell und kreativ mit Sprache um').

K:category-sort.why: Sorting pictures under a heading (Oberbegriff) prepares 'Wortsammlungen nach thematischen ... Gesichtspunkten'.

K:letter-identification.why: Telling letters apart, also inside words, is the first part of 'unterscheiden Buchstaben, Silben, Wörter und Sätze'.

K:letter-formation.why: Tracing the print letters comes before writing 'flüssig und formklar in Druckschrift'.

K:count-syllables.why: Clapping and counting Silben prepares telling 'Silben' from letters and words and the spelling strategy 'silbierendes Sprechen'.

K:letter-case.why: Knowing each letter in both forms is letter knowledge needed before reading and writing; the plan has no wording of its own for it.

K:beginning-sounds.why: Hearing the Anlaut and linking it with a letter is the start of the 'Lautprinzip der deutschen Orthographie'.

K:category-odd-one-out.why: Deciding which picture does not fit a category builds the Oberbegriffe behind thematic 'Wortsammlungen'; a weak but real link.

K:opposites.why: Pairs of opposites are vocabulary ordered by meaning, a step toward the 'Aufbau eines individuellen Wortschatzes'.

K:alphabet-order.why: Knowing the order of the alphabet is the base of 'finden auf Grundlage des Alphabets Wörter in Wörterverzeichnissen'.

K:story-sequencing.why: Ordering story pictures prepares retelling 'gestützt durch ... Bilder' and describing the 'Handlungsverlauf' of short texts.

K:sound-position.why: Hearing where a sound sits in a word (Anlaut, Inlaut, Auslaut) is needed before writing by sound.

K:vowels-consonants.why: Selbstlaute and Mitlaute are first technical terms about words ('Fachbegriffe') and help with writing by sound and by syllable.

K:bilingual-cards.why: Word cards in two languages give the 'Erfahrungen mit verschiedenen Sprachen' the expectation builds on and are a first word collection.

K:segment-phonemes.why: One sound per box, with sch / ch sharing a box, is the analysis behind 'beherrschen sicher das Lautprinzip'.

K:cvc-build.why: Building short sound-true words from letters is first writing by the Lautprinzip and first word reading.

K:word-picture-match.why: Reading single words and matching them to pictures comes before 'erlesen Texte durch die Identifikation von Wörtern und Sätzen'.

K:singular-plural.why: Einzahl and Mehrzahl is the first thing children find out about Nomen, before words are sorted into Wortarten.

K:digraphs-k.why: For German this means hearing sch / ch at the start of a word: one sound written with several letters, part of the Lautprinzip.

K:sight-words-reading.why: 'identifizieren vertraute Wörter auf einen Blick (Sichtwortschatz)' is the school target; before school it is preparation.

K:word-sentence-tracing.why: Tracing words and sentences in print with gaps between words prepares Druckschrift and the difference between 'Wörter und Sätze'.

K:articles.why: The expectation names 'Artikel' among the Wortarten; choosing der / die / das for a noun is its first step.

1:rhyming.why: Finishing and making rhymes is 'gehen experimentell und kreativ mit Sprache um (u. a. poetische Sprache)'; hearing word endings also supports writing by sound.

1:phoneme-boxes.why: Splitting a word into its sounds and blending them is the work on the 'Lautprinzip der deutschen Orthographie'.

1:digraphs.why: In German: sch, ch (and others such as ei, au, eu) as letter groups for one sound, part of the Lautprinzip. 'th' has no German counterpart.

1:spell-picture-words.why: Writing sound-true picture words is the core task behind 'beherrschen sicher das Lautprinzip'.

1:syllables-split.why: 'unterscheiden Buchstaben, Silben, Wörter' and the strategies 'silbierendes Sprechen', 'Wörter zerlegen'.

1:syllable-vowel.why: Finding the vowel in each syllable is work on the Silbe as a unit and the check that goes with 'silbierendes Sprechen' when writing.

1:word-families-syllable-reading.why: 'identifizieren ... Silben auf einen Blick' and reading words from them; the English word-family sheets correspond to German syllable reading.

1:alphabetical-order.why: Ordering words by first and second letter is the skill behind 'finden auf Grundlage des Alphabets Wörter in Wörterverzeichnissen'; the lookup in a real word list is not on the sheet.

1:opposites.why: Pairs of opposites are vocabulary collected by meaning ('für den Aufbau eines individuellen Wortschatzes'); only this vocabulary part of the expectation is met.

1:articles.why: 'ordnen Wörtern Wortarten (u. a. Nomen ... Artikel) zu': sorting nouns by der / die / das.

1:read-and-follow.why: The child reads sentences ('Identifikation von Wörtern und Sätzen') and must take out each single piece of information to act on it.

1:cloze.why: Choosing the word that fits a sentence and matching sentence and picture is reading at word and sentence level.

1:synonyms.why: Words with the same meaning are a word collection by meaning; the vocabulary part of the expectation.

1:unscramble-sentence.why: Building a sentence from words works on 'Wörter und Sätze'; moving words about prepares flexible sentence building with Satzglieder; capital at the start and end mark are first cases of 'Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Zeichensetzung', worded for Klasse 4.

1:question-words.why: W-Fragen (wer, was, wo) are the tool with which Satzglieder are later found, and the question is one of the 'Satzarten'; the sheets do neither formally yet.

1:story-sequencing.why: Ordering sentences and pictures of a story is work on the 'Handlungsverlauf von kurzen literarischen Texten'; it prepares oral retelling with pictures.

1:word-classes.why: 'ordnen Wörtern Wortarten (u. a. Nomen, Verben, Adjektive ...) zu'.

1:pronouns.why: Pronouns fall under the 'u. a.' of the Wortarten; replacing a name by er / sie is a first 'Ersetzen', which the plan names as a Sprachprobe for Klasse 4. NRW schools usually treat pronouns in Klasse 3/4.

1:shades-of-meaning.why: Ordering near-synonyms by strength is vocabulary work by meaning and prepares 'beschreiben die Wirkung von sprachlichen Mitteln'.

1:root-words.why: Finding the word built from a stem is 'identifizieren Wortbausteine' (Wortstamm); it prepares using the stem for spelling ('Ableiten').

1:story-writing.why: A story map is a 'Strukturierungs- und Planungshilfe', the child then writes from it, and story, description and postcard are 'Texte mit verschiedenen Textfunktionen'.

2:digraphs.why: In German: finding sch (or ch, ei ...) in sentences, a letter group for one sound; part of the Lautprinzip.

2:sentence-boundaries.why: Choosing . or ? is 'unterscheiden verschiedene Satzarten'; finding where a sentence ends is telling 'Sätze' apart; capital and end mark are first cases of the Klasse 4 wording 'Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Zeichensetzung'.

2:cursive-writing.why: The Schuleingangsphase expectation is 'Druckschrift'; a 'gut lesbare verbundene Handschrift' is asked only by the end of Klasse 4, so letters and joins in Klasse 2 are the way toward it.

2:cloze-context.why: Choosing the word from the story context is 'verknüpfen Informationen in Texten (lokale Kohärenz)' while reading a simple text.

2:question-words.why: Asking for a highlighted part of a sentence with wer / wo / warum / wie is the informal step before 'unterscheiden Satzglieder'; it also works with the question as a sentence type.

2:read-and-answer.why: 'lesen einfache Texte', 'identifizieren Einzelinformationen in Texten' (who, what, where, when) and, for why, linking information.

2:describe-a-picture.why: Writing with word bank and sentence starters is writing with 'sprachlichen Mustern ... nach Vorgaben'; the picture is the 'Impuls' for ideas.

2:word-classes.why: 'ordnen Wörtern Wortarten (u. a. Nomen, Verben, Adjektive ...) zu', using the terms.

2:plural-nouns.why: Forming the Mehrzahl is work on the Nomen; German plurals with Umlaut (Haus / Häuser) and the long form (Hund / Hunde) prepare 'Ableiten' and 'Verlängern' as spelling helps.

2:spelling-rules.why: For German this means patterns such as ck / k, tz / z, ie: 'identifizieren anhand prototypischer Beispiele die Grundprinzipien der deutschen Orthographie'; applying rules ('wenden orthografische ... Regeln an') is worded for Klasse 4. The English patterns in the skill line (tch, dge, ai / ay, -ies) have no German counterpart.

2:synonyms.why: Matching words of the same meaning is vocabulary work by meaning; choosing another word for 'sagen' (Wortfeld sagen) prepares 'beschreiben die Wirkung von sprachlichen Mitteln'.

2:synonyms~doing-stage.why: Same skill as 2:synonyms: word collection by meaning; the Wortfeld 'sagen' prepares work on the effect of word choice.

2:verb-forms.why: Finding the verb is Wortarten work; present and past forms (sein, haben, gehen ...) are grammar that the plan words for Klasse 4 ('wenden ... grammatische Regeln an'). NRW schools treat Zeitformen in Klasse 3/4.

2:pronouns.why: Pronouns come under the 'u. a.' of the Wortarten; replacing a name is the Sprachprobe 'Ersetzen' named for Klasse 4.

2:read-cursive.why: The plan has no reading expectation for joined script; being able to read it is a step toward writing 'in einer gut lesbaren verbundenen Handschrift'.

2:compound-words.why: Building and splitting zusammengesetzte Nomen is 'identifizieren Wortbausteine' and the strategy 'Wörter zerlegen'; naming 'Zusammensetzung' as a way of word formation is the Klasse 4 expectation.

2:root-words.why: Wortfamilien: finding the shared Wortstamm ('Wortbausteine', 'bekannte Stamm-Morpheme') and sorting by it, the base of 'Ableiten und Analogiebildung'.

2:prefixes.why: German sheets use ver-, vor-, un-, be- ...: 'identifizieren Wortbausteine' and 'häufig wiederkehrende Morpheme (u. a. ver-, vor-, nach- als Präfixe)'; 'Ableitung' as word formation is Klasse 4.

2:retell-with-starters.why: Writing a picture story with given sentence openers (Zuerst, Dann, Danach, Am Ende) uses 'sprachliche Muster' and a structure help; the oral retelling 'gestützt durch ... Bilder' is prepared, not done.

2:mystery-animal.why: The child links several read clues ('verknüpfen Informationen') and tells animals apart by body and food ('unterscheiden typische Tiere ... (u. a. Körperbau, Ernährung)').

2:animal-fact-file.why: A Steckbrief on food, habitat, movement and body is Sachunterricht content on typical animals and a text written 'nach Vorgaben'.

2:compare-two-animals.why: 'unterscheiden typische Tiere' by their features; sorting facts into same / different prepares the reading strategy 'Informationen sortieren, passende Strukturhilfen nutzen'.

3:cursive-sentences.why: 'schreiben flüssig ... in einer gut lesbaren verbundenen Handschrift': copying whole sentences in joined writing.

3:word-fields.why: Wortfelder (gehen, sehen) are 'Wortsammlungen nach thematischen ... Gesichtspunkten'; telling close words apart prepares describing the effect of word choice.

3:person-words.why: backen - Bäcker, laufen - Läufer: 'unterscheiden Möglichkeiten der Wortbildung (... Ableitung ...)'.

3:root-words-in-context.why: Choosing the right member of a Wortfamilie for a sentence needs 'strukturieren Wörter' by stem and endings and the use of grammar rules.

K:human-body.why: 'beschreiben Körperteile des Menschen und deren Funktion (u. a. Kopf, Rumpf, Gliedmaßen ...)': naming the parts comes first.

K:living-nonliving.why: No single expectation names living / non-living; the idea is the ground for the whole Schwerpunkt 'Tiere, Pflanzen, Lebensräume'.

K:fruit-vegetable.why: Which part of the plant we eat leads to 'Teile der Pflanze'; fruit and vegetables lead to 'gesunde Ernährung'.

K:animal-groups-homes.why: Pets, farm and wild animals and their homes prepare 'unterscheiden typische Tiere in deren Lebensräumen' and their dependence on the habitat.

K:animal-babies.why: Matching young and parents by how they look is a first look at 'Körperbau' of typical animals.

K:day-night.why: Day and night is a first 'Naturphänomen' to name and the most basic division of time.

K:weather-temperature.why: The plan does not name weather; it falls under 'benennen und beschreiben Naturphänomene', whose only example is Magnetismus.

K:natural-made.why: 'ordnen Materialien und Gegenstände aus ihrem Alltag nach ausgewählten Aspekten': natural or made is one such aspect.

K:five-senses.why: 'untersuchen Leistung und Aufgaben der eigenen Sinne': knowing which organ does what comes first.

K:recycling.why: Sorting waste is ordering things by material and a first action for 'Natur- und Umweltschutz', which the plan words for Klasse 4.

K:plant-needs.why: Water and light are the first 'Abhängigkeiten von ... Pflanzen von ihrem Lebensraum' and part of plant 'Entwicklung'.

K:sink-float.why: Schwimmen und Sinken is a phenomenon to name and later to examine 'in Versuchen'; a sorting sheet comes before the experiment.

1:animal-classes-coverings.why: 'unterscheiden typische Tiere ... (u. a. Körperbau ...)': grouping by fur, feathers, scales.

1:habitats-needs.why: 'typische Tiere in deren Lebensräumen (u. a. ... Ernährung)' and 'Abhängigkeiten von Tieren ... von ihrem Lebensraum'.

1:life-cycles.why: The plant cycle is the 'Entwicklung' named for plants; animal development (chicken, butterfly, frog) is covered only by the 'u. a.' of the animal expectation.

1:sink-float.why: The sheet names and describes the phenomenon; 'untersuchen in Versuchen ... Eigenschaften von Stoffen' needs the real test with water, which a sheet can only frame.

1:body-parts.why: 'beschreiben Körperteile des Menschen': the naming part; functions are only touched.

1:five-senses.why: The 'Aufgaben der eigenen Sinne' part of the expectation; testing what the senses can do ('Leistung') needs practical work.

1:weather.why: Weather is not named in the NRW plan; it is a 'Naturphänomen' to name and describe. Reading a week forecast is taking data from a table.

1:materials-recycling.why: 'ordnen Materialien und Gegenstände aus ihrem Alltag nach ausgewählten Aspekten' (what it is made of); recycling prepares the Klasse 4 expectation on Umweltschutz.

1:sun-earth-moon.why: Only the moon-phase sheets fit, as a 'Naturphänomen' to name and describe; Sun, Earth and Moon facts are not in the NRW Sachunterricht plan.

2:materials.why: Grouping things by material is the s-expectation; doing it for recycling prepares the Umweltschutz expectation of Klasse 4.

2:plant-parts.why: 'Teile der Pflanze' with their jobs; which part we eat is an application.

2:life-cycles.why: Development of animals is not named, only 'u. a. Körperbau, Ernährung'; matching young stages to the adult animal is telling typical animals apart.

2:moon-phases.why: 'benennen und beschreiben Naturphänomene'; the moon is not named in the plan, so the link rests on the open wording.

2:day-and-night.why: Describing day and night is the s-expectation; explaining it by the turning Earth goes toward 'Naturphänomene im Hinblick auf physikalische ... Gesetzmäßigkeiten' of Klasse 4.

2:habitats-adaptations.why: Animals and plants of a habitat and their dependence on it are s-expectations; the body feature that helps is a first case of 'Prinzip der Angepasstheit' (Klasse 4).

2:sink-float.why: Describing that shape changes floating is describing the phenomenon; the examination 'in Versuchen' is the real clay-boat test the sheet goes with.

3:water-cycle.why: 'untersuchen Stoffkreisläufe': the Wasserkreislauf is the standard example in Klasse 3/4, although the wording names only 'Atmung'; the sheet covers the naming part.

3:flower-parts.why: The plan asks for 'Teile der Pflanze' by Klasse 2 and names nothing finer; parts of the flower go beyond it on the same line.

3:life-cycles-compare.why: Comparing two development cycles goes beyond telling typical animals apart; no Klasse 4 expectation names animal development.

3:planets.none: the solar system is not in the NRW Sachunterricht plan
3:planets.why: No expectation in the list names planets or space; SU.4.1.k3 stops at 'Welt'.

3:investigation.why: Predict, test, record and conclude on floating is 'untersuchen Naturphänomene im Hinblick auf physikalische ... Gesetzmäßigkeiten', provided the test is really done; planning own 'Versuche und Experimente' is named for stoffliche Umwandlung.

K:birds-eye-view.why: Seeing things from above is the idea needed before 'lesen und zeichnen einfache Pläne'.

K:family.why: Family words come before describing 'Lebenssituationen ... (u. a. Familienformen ...)'.

K:transport-flying.why: Sorting vehicles by land, water and air prepares 'beschreiben verschiedene Formen von Mobilität'.

K:community-helpers.why: Known jobs and their tools prepare 'aus dem Alltag bekannte Berufe' and 'Funktion ausgewählter ... Werkzeuge und Geräte für die Arbeitswelt'.

1:map-key.why: Reading symbols from a key is part of 'lesen ... einfache Pläne'; the plan means plans of places the child knows, and real map work comes in Klasse 3/4.

1:family-generations.why: The own family tree is a way to describe 'Familienformen'; ordering generations by age prepares the timeline of the own life story.

2:cardinal-directions.why: 'orientieren sich mit ... Karten und anderen Hilfsmittel ... (Sonnenstand ... Kompass ...)' is a Klasse 4 expectation; NRW has nothing on compass directions in classes 1/2.

2:continents.why: 'größere räumliche Einheiten (Nordrhein-Westfalen, Deutschland, Europa, Welt)' is Klasse 3/4 and starts from the child's own surroundings; a continents sheet in Klasse 2 is early.

2:family-relationships.why: Words such as Tante, Cousin, Großmutter are needed to describe 'Familienformen'; the riddles do not yet compare ways of living.

3:continents-oceans.why: The 'Welt' part of 'größere räumliche Einheiten'; NRW, Deutschland and Europa, named first in the wording, are not on these sheets.

K:healthy-food.why: 'Grundsätze ... der gesunden Lebensführung (u. a. ... gesunde Ernährung ...)'.

K:hygiene-habits.why: 'Grundsätze der Körperpflege ... (u. a. Mundhygiene und Zahnpflege ...)'.

K:road-safety.why: 'berücksichtigen wichtige Verkehrsregeln und Verkehrszeichen'; traffic light and crossing steps are the first rules.

1:food-groups.why: The 'gesunde Ernährung' part of the expectation.

1:healthy-habits.why: 'Mundhygiene und Zahnpflege' is named; choosing the healthy action is 'beurteilen den individuellen Einfluss auf die Gesundheit'.

1:road-signs.why: Knowing 'Verkehrszeichen' and what they mean is the knowledge part of the expectation; acting on it in traffic is practised outside.

2:healthy-habits-why.why: Giving the reason for each habit is describing the 'Grundsätze' and judging the own influence on health.

2:road-signs.why: Kinds of signs and the sign for a situation: 'wichtige Verkehrsregeln und Verkehrszeichen'.

K:how-to-draw.none: drawing by steps belongs to Kunst, which is not among the three plans
K:how-to-draw.why: Deutsch, Mathematik and Sachunterricht have no expectation for drawing a picture; M.2.5.s1 means geometric lines and figures, not pictures.

1:how-to-draw.none: drawing by steps belongs to Kunst, which is not among the three plans
1:how-to-draw.why: No expectation of the three plans asks for drawing a figure from steps.

2:drawing.why: Only the 'write about it' part counts: the own drawing is the 'Impuls' for ideas before writing ('Bilder ... als Impulse'). Drawing itself is Kunst.

K:same-different-visual.none: visual discrimination is a readiness skill, not named in the plans
K:same-different-visual.why: No expectation asks for finding identical or different pictures.

K:mazes.none: a maze is not in the NRW plans
K:mazes.why: The number and letter routes repeat counting and the alphabet, but the task itself is a puzzle with no expectation.

K:shadow-closure.none: visual perception training is not named in the plans
K:shadow-closure.why: Matching shadows and parts to wholes is pre-school perception work with no expectation behind it.

K:spot-the-difference.none: spot-the-difference is not in the NRW plans
K:spot-the-difference.why: Comparing two pictures is perception training; no wording covers it.

K:matrix-logic.none: logic puzzles are not content expectations
K:matrix-logic.why: Completing a picture grid is logical reasoning, a process competence that is not in the list.

K:grid-copy.why: Copying on a grid prepares 'zeichnen ... ebene Figuren und Muster ... mit Hilfsmitteln (u. a. ... Gitterpapier)'.

1:find-the-differences.none: spot-the-difference is not in the NRW plans
1:find-the-differences.why: Visual discrimination has no expectation in Deutsch, Mathematik or Sachunterricht.

1:mazes.none: a maze is not in the NRW plans
1:mazes.why: Finding a way through a picture maze is a puzzle; M.2.1.s2 asks for describing ways in words, which a maze does not do.

1:grid-copy.why: 'zeichnen Linien, ebene Figuren und Muster ... mit Hilfsmitteln (u. a. ... Gitterpapier)': copying square by square on a grid.

1:picture-analogies.none: analogies are reasoning tasks, not content of the plans
1:picture-analogies.why: No expectation names A is to B as C is to ?.

1:secret-code.why: Coding and decoding with a key is the experience behind 'unterscheiden zwischen Codierung und Verschlüsselung von Daten', a Klasse 4 expectation.

1:picture-sudoku.none: sudoku is not in the NRW plans
1:picture-sudoku.why: A logic puzzle; the content expectations of Mathematik do not include it.

1:logic-picture-clues.none: logic grids are not content expectations
1:logic-picture-clues.why: Reasoning from clues is a process competence, which is not in the list.

2:find-differences.why: Finding the differences has no expectation; only the face where the child writes a sentence about each difference is a small step toward writing texts with given patterns.

2:logic-grid.none: logic grids are not content expectations
2:logic-grid.why: Solving from yes / no clues is reasoning; nothing in the three plans' content lists covers it.

3:two-attribute-sort.why: A row-by-column table for two attributes is 'strukturieren Daten ... mithilfe von Tabellen'; the Venn form is not named but does the same job.

3:two-attribute-sort~logic-cabinet.why: Same skill as 3:two-attribute-sort: ordering things in a two-way table.

3:logic-grids.none: logic grids are not content expectations
3:logic-grids.why: Reasoning from clues is a process competence, which is not in the list.

3:latin-square-sudoku.none: sudoku is not in the NRW plans
3:latin-square-sudoku.why: A logic puzzle without number or geometry content.

K:feelings.why: 'benennen ... eigene Gefühle', 'beschreiben eigene Gefühle auch unterstützt durch visuelle Hilfsmittel (Symbole)' and 'deuten Mimik': face and feeling-word sheets come before all three.
